card.name: Sentence ends in warnings and guidance
card.fires_on: Mostly the period (sometimes a comma) closing a clinical advice or warning sentence in a drug label, just before the next sentence begins. Occasionally a linking word or a partway-through-word piece in a citation or trial text.

modes.label: Period after advice
modes.description: Full stop or comma ending a sentence about monitoring, diagnosis or avoiding a drug in a patient group.
modes.example: Effective diagnostic and therapeutic strategies should be employed in patients with symptoms of infection while on therapy<<.>> Consider interruption of treatment with PONV

modes.label: Reference or statistics bits
modes.description: A word or number piece inside a citation title, drug name or p-value.
modes.example: A Global Strategy<< for>> Malaria Control. Geneva: World Health
